:::{#rem-training-mse-optimistic}
#### Training error is optimistic

The same argument fails for the training set.
The training pairs are not independent of $\mathcal{T}$:
they are $\mathcal{T}$,
and $\fitted$ was fitted to make their prediction errors small.
So the third line of @sol-held-out-unbiased does not hold for them,
and the training mean squared error is typically *smaller*
than $\generr_{\mathcal{T}}$ [@hastie2009elements, sec. 7.4].
@exr-overfitting shows the pattern:
training RMSE keeps falling as the degree grows,
while held-out RMSE does not.

:::
